note: A ball hangs 1 m below a fixed body (axis straight down, separation 0 to 2.5 m). Gravity slides it along the axis until it rests against the maxSeparation limit at 2.5 m below, with no sideways drift. Body 1 sits at the origin because X_ITE 16.6.0 builds both slider frames from body 1's position.
gaps: separation is measured along the axis between the two body origins, as in X_ITE's slider
sliderForce is applied by the bridge as a force along the axis; X_ITE 16.6.0 reads the field and never applies it
stopBounce is kept and not used by the slider
